subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The project was simple, but it taught energy transfer clearly.”?
options: The school radio did not become louder.
Dark ground held more heat than grass.
Sunlight could become heat if captured well.
Heat is a design problem as well as a weather problem.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The school radio did not become louder.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Dark ground held more heat than grass.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The project was simple, but it taught energy transfer clearly. Sunlight could become heat if captured well.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Heat is a design problem as well as a weather problem.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The project was simple, but it taught energy transfer clearly. Sunlight could become heat if captured well.」，答案為「Sunlight could become heat if captured well.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Sunlight could become heat if captured well.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
